data.title: Future: docket deps ready - show bugs ready to work on
data.body:
Show bugs that have no unresolved dependencies and are ready to work on.

```
$ docket deps ready

Ready to work (4 bugs):

HIGH:
  stu7: Add session management [Approved]
        (unblocks: 2 bugs)

MEDIUM:
  jkl4: Design API endpoints [Approved]
        (unblocks: 1 bug → abc1 → 3 more)
  def2: Set up database schema [InProgress]

LOW:
  (none)
```

This answers "what should I work on next?" with priority-awareness and shows downstream impact.

## Future idea

Only implement if there's clear user need beyond `docket list` with dependency indicators.
